local_cache_policy: docs/local_source_cache/ preserves optional personal reading copies. Published inventories and Git-tracked files exclude that cache. Missing cache files are permitted; present registered copies must match their original PDF size and SHA-256.
source_rights_policy: Publish unchanged PDFs only when a verified, source-specific CC BY 4.0 or CC0 grant covers their exact retained version or matching deposited bytes. Preserve attribution, original notices and license links. Preserve all other downloaded originals in ignored local reading storage, with external URL, digest, reading scope and exact rights evidence in the registry; optional caches do not enter Git or public checksum inventories. The policy records admission evidence rather than asserting that every excluded source forbids all possible reuse.
